description: This file implements the functionality for adding an article to the current user's favorites. It defines a command, validation, and a handler to process the logic of favoriting an article identified by its slug.

classes.name: Add
classes.description: Contains nested classes for command, validation, and handler related to adding an article to favorites.

classes.name: Add.Command
classes.description: Represents the command to add an article to favorites identified by slug.

classes.name: Add.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates the Command to ensure the slug is not null or empty.

classes.name: Add.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the process of adding an article to the current user's favorites and returning the article data.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the command to favorite an article: retrieves the article, verifies existence, gets current user, adds favorite if not already favorited, and returns the article envelope.
